0x0008B1.en: 「So... this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008E3.en: 「With my skills now...@ this is my limit...!」

0x000954.en: 「Argh!@ So this is as far as I go...!!」

0x0009DC.en: 「Damn it!@ Next time you won't get me!」

0x000A85.en: 「Tch!! What a short show that was!」

0x000B05.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000B3D.en: 「Uh oh...@ how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000C06.en: 「Gah! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000C41.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@ Not funny...」

0x000C95.en: 「I blew it...!@ No choice but to bail...」

0x000D7F.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000DE6.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is yours.」

0x000E92.en: 「No good, I've taken too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000EDF.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000F1D.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000F64.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x00100F.en: 「Gah...! So I'm to be a shooting star...! Ejecting!」

0x00108E.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x0010C6.en: 「Ow, ow, ow... You got me. I miscalculated.」

0x0011B8.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0011FF.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x001234.en: 「Damn! Is this the limit of my power...!?」

0x001320.en: 「To fall in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x00136E.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x0014C5.en: 「I can't go on. Please excuse me.」

0x001550.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001A1E.en: 「...You can refuse, same as always.@ Especially this time.」

0x001A7A.en: 「No. If there's something I can do, I'll go.」

0x001AEB.en: 「...I have no memory of my past,@ and no place to belong... So being needed,@ whatever the reason, puts me at ease.」

0x001BA9.en: 「Sorry about this, Ing. We'll be counting on you too.」

0x001C33.en: 「Yes.@ Not one of the crew asked to disembark, either.」

0x001C86.en: 「The whole maintenance team's united. They say@ they'll follow Princess Xenia anywhere she goes.」

0x001D06.en: 「It's like she's got her own idol fan club...」

0x001D59.en: 「By the way, what's the status of King Feil's forces?」

0x001D99.en: 「Stationed at Nagor Bay.@ If nothing changes, we'll make it in time.」

0x001DF8.en: 「Then all hands, board your units and stand by.」

0x001E42.en: （Prince Feil... We're coming for you.@ To stop you...!）

0x001EA4.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Baldia State, Nagor Bay

0x001FA0.en: 「Still approaching...@ It'll enter the current battle zone shortly.」

0x001FF9.en: 「Battle zone, is it.@ If a clash can't be avoided, then so be it.」

0x00205C.en: 「General Ort, you and your men, withdraw.@ Prepare for the battle to come.」

0x0020CD.en: 「That order I cannot obey.@ I'll follow you to the very end, Majesty.」

0x002166.en: 「No... Your ideals and your anguish, Majesty,@ I understand them to my very bones.」

0x0021D1.en: 「And every man here has resolved to@ devote body and soul for your sake.」

0x002242.en: 「If you still say we're not needed,@ then strike me down first.」

0x0022C0.en: 「But this Browel I've raised with my own hands...@ Even against your Duraxil, or a Machine God itself,@ it will not fall behind.」

0x0023B2.en: 「Save the rest of those words@ for after the deed is done.」

0x002402.en: 「Masaki...@ Have you reconsidered, come to lend your aid?」

0x00248C.en: 「Is that... your judgment as a Machine God pilot?」

0x0024DC.en: 「So you still believe my actions will bring@ disaster upon <La Gias>?」

0x002549.en: 「I do.@ Louzorl and the others are already moving in the chaos.@ And Kirkus is still out there somewhere...」

0x0025E8.en: 「General Kirkus fell in battle a short while ago.@ In the clash with Yang Long and the Hiryu Kai.」

0x002663.en: 「So the threat at my back is gone.@ Masaki, I'm sorry to you and the others, but...@ I'll walk the path I believe in.」

0x002708.en: 「Brother! What must be done now isn't@ an invasion of Shutedonias, it's@ stabilizing Langran!」

0x002798.en: 「I told you, Xenia.@ Subjugating Shutedonias by force is@ what leads to peace across all of La Gias.」

0x002828.en: 「Not just Shutedonias!@ You'd turn every nation in La Gias against us!?」

0x0028AF.en: 「This is madness, Majesty! Even if every Machine God@ rallied beneath you, defeating the surrounding@ nations in war would be impossible!」

0x002963.en: 「I'll do whatever it takes for my goal...@ No great ambition is achieved without ruthlessness.」

0x0029D4.en: 「You think you can sum it all up with words like that!?」

0x002A42.en: 「I know that!@ But the people dragged into a war that didn't@ need to happen, that's unbearable!」

0x002AC3.en: 「Whether it's necessary is for me, the King, to decide.@ If you mean to stand in the way of my great wish,@ I'll show you no mercy either.」

0x002BCF.en: 「Ngh! Feil, are you serious!?@ You really mean to fight us!?」

0x002C31.en: 「Yes, I do. Just as you are bound by your@ duty as Machine God pilots, I have a duty of my own@ to fulfill as King.」

0x002CFB.en: 「Yes, these are extraordinary times.@ I don't want war either, but if I hesitate now,@ an even greater conflict will erupt before long.」

0x002DB5.en: 「By then, it will be too late.」

0x002DE6.en: 「That's insane! Keeping that from happening@ is your job, isn't it!? Take the time, mend@ your ties with the other nations...!」

0x002E94.en: 「...I can't do that... I cannot, Masaki.」

0x002EEA.en: 「So no matter what, you intend to open@ hostilities with Shutedonias?」

0x002F52.en: 「Ngh! Throwing your own country into crisis, and you call@ yourself King!? You're possessed by ambition,@ just like Kirkus was!」

0x003000.en: 「Not ambition, a cause. I act not for Langran alone,@ but for all of La Gias.」

0x003080.en: 「If you won't back down no matter what...@ then I'll stop you by force!」

0x003119.en: 「I know!@ We drag Feil down out of that Duraxil!」

0x00317B.en: 「And if we can, General Ort and his men too...!」

0x0031B2.en: 「You mean, don't let them die for nothing.@ A tall order, but we've got no choice.」

0x003217.en: 「Lt. Colonel Tetsuya, I'm sorry.@ That it's come to this...!」

0x003285.en: 「No choice.@ To resolve this, we'll join the fight too.」

0x0032DB.en: 「So we can get back to the surface with Kyosuke and the rest.」

0x00331E.en: 「Then let's go, Masaki...@ With the fate of La Gias on the line!」

0x00337A.en: 「The duty of a Machine God pilot you taught me...!@ Now's when I make good on it!!」

0x0033EE.en: 「G-guh... So my Browel@ ends here too...!」

0x003463.en: 「I go on ahead, Majesty...!@ And someday... again... together...!」

0x0034E4.en: 「Wh-why...? You should have@ been able to eject...!」

0x003534.en: （Forgive me, Kevin...@ I'll give my thanks when we meet in that land beyond...）

0x003590.en: 「Honestly... I never wanted to fight you.@ But there's no other way now, is there!」

0x003607.en: 「This single battle ends everything...!@ No matter which of us wins...@ that's the kind of fight this is!」

0x00368E.en: 「Majesty, tell me why!@ Otherwise I... I...!」

0x0036E7.en: 「Forgive me, Tytti.@ Let's end this as fast as we can...@ I have no time...!」

0x003775.en: 「Brother's way is wrong!@ I don't understand him anymore!」

0x0037E9.en: 「Xenia, so you turn against me too.@ Heh, truly my sister...@ Good. That's as it should be...」

0x003873.en: 「Since Zamzeed chose me,@ I'm a Machine God pilot too! I'm ready for this!」

0x0038F0.en: 「Good eyes, Mio... Ricardo found a fine successor.@ A worthy opponent for me, as well!」

0x00396D.en: 「Your Highness, I'm Zeoruit's daughter!@ If it were my father, I know... he'd have done@ the very same thing I'm doing!」

0x003A03.en: 「Heh... a fine stance, Presia.@　Like your father, you'll surely@　become a great warrior...」

0x003A77.en: 「If you too, like my father,@　would dare to wield your power by force...@　then I'll be the one to stop you!」

0x003B04.en: 「I see... in your heart you respected@　your father, and loved him.」

0x003B6D.en: 「I think I understand how you feel,@　Raideus...」

0x003BBD.en: 「You think a Browel can go toe to toe@　with the Cybuster?!@　Stay out of this, old man!」

0x003C47.en: 「Don't underestimate my machine,@　Sir Masaki! Here I come!」

0x003CB2.en: 「I respect your loyalty, General Ort...@　but I am a Machine God pilot!」

0x003D35.en: 「You needn't tell me, Lady Tytti.@　I too shall do my duty!@　Come at me without holding back!」

0x003DDD.en: 「Hey, wait a second! What is that Browel?!@ That's just plain cheating!」

0x003E4B.en: 「Cheat, or heart, whatever you call it,@　you saw through my machine's power. A true@　Machine God pilot indeed!」

0x003EC8.en: 「To pull that many modifications out of a@　mass-produced Browel...@　I've got new respect for you, General Ort.」

0x003F5E.en: 「You honor me greatly. But if you would@　deny His Majesty's cause, then I'll show@　no mercy, not even to you, Lady Xenia!」

0x003FFA.en: 「Up close, I can see it's every bit the@　machine they say it is...! It looks similar,@　but its power is a world above mine!」

0x004093.en: 「You were Lieutenant Torres Zetiquinez,@　in charge of guarding Luzack province...」

0x004101.en: 「A soldier of Langran, yet you draw your@　bow against His Majesty... an unforgivable sin!」

0x004175.en: 「If only I had the funds, I'd give my@　machine those same modifications...!」

0x0041E0.en: 「Hah, money alone can't achieve this!@　You must know every last inch of a Browel!」

0x004260.en: 「To draw out that much power while barely@　changing the look... that takes real@　knowledge and dedication...!」

0x004314.en: 「Mm, a promising lad.@　A shame to have you as an enemy.」

0x00436A.en: 「...You've come this far. No need to hold@　back. Come at me with everything, or you'll@　never stop this Duraxil.」

0x004403.en: 「Feil! What's driving you to fight@　this reckless battle?!」

0x00446B.en: 「You can't bring yourself to strike me@　in earnest without knowing why...」

0x0044AB.en: 「Then I'll tell you...@　The blame for summoning the surface-dwellers@　here and causing this chaos... lies with me.」

0x00459B.en: 「It may sound like an excuse, but...@　an accident sent the summoning program out@　of control, and far more were called than planned.」

0x004655.en: 「The cause is still unknown...@　No, perhaps it was no accident at all,@　but something deliberately set up.」

0x0046D9.en: 「But that the mass summoning of@　surface-dwellers threw La Gias into chaos@　is an undeniable fact.」

0x004763.en: 「Don't tell me you mean to set it right...?!」

0x00479D.en: 「I never intended to force through a plan@　to unify La Gias from the start. But when@　I learned how little time I had left...」

0x004849.en: 「It's also true that I resolved to take@　responsibility while this life remains.」

0x0048E8.en: 「To realize my ideal... I needed the@　throne, no matter the cost...」

0x004944.en: 「And for that, I had to strengthen the@ magic power I'd lacked since birth.」

0x0049AC.en: 「I barely passed the magic test, but the@　brutal training and drug side effects had@　pushed my body to its limit...」

0x004A45.en: 「On top of that, the wound from the terror@　attack in the capital proved fatal...@　I have half a year left, at most.」

0x004AE7.en: 「E-even so, there's no reason to rush like@　this, to solve everything through force...!!」

0x004B58.en: 「Through all these battles, I came to@　understand... I am a soldier at heart.」

0x004BC0.en: 「And a soldier honors solving things by@　force. To go easy on such a man...@　that is nothing but an insult.」

0x004C84.en: 「The time left to me is short...@　So I'll remove anyone who stands in the@　way of my dream, whoever they may be.」

0x004D05.en: 「If you mean to take responsibility for@　the summoning, the path you've chosen is wrong...!」

0x004D85.en: 「That's right!@　Finding the surface-dwellers called to@　La Gias and sending them home, that's...!」

0x004E15.en: 「The moment the summoning program ran wild,@　the die was cast.」

0x004E6E.en: 「Of course, I'm sorry for dragging@　you all into this...」

0x004ED9.en: 「If the nations learn the truth of the@　summoning, they'll condemn us by every means.@　And that would only bring more chaos...」

0x004F87.en: 「If you'd unify La Gias to stop that from@　happening, you've got it completely backwards!」

0x004FF8.en: 「This is no means to hide facts or shift@　blame. Even without the summoning, disaster@　by the demon god has been prophesied.」

0x0050B5.en: 「Before it's all too late, I'll unify@　La Gias by force and bring order to it...!」

0x005136.en: 「If you too fear for this world's future,@　then stop me with all your strength!」

0x0051A4.en: 「The war you're trying to start is nothing@　but a private feud...!」

0x005209.en: 「Feil! As a Machine God pilot, I'll@　smash your ambition to pieces!!」

0x005274.en: 「There's no turning back for you now, Feil...!@　Then at the very least, I'll be the one to@　bring down the curtain!」

0x0052F4.en: 「I can't let it end yet, Masaki.@　For the future of all La Gias...@　and to take responsibility.」

0x00539C.en: 「You'll take responsibility another way!@　After I drag you down from that Duraxil!」

0x005451.en: 「What's wrong?! No need to hold back!@　Defeating me is your duty as Machine God@　pilots, isn't it?!」

0x0054CE.en: 「Fine, then. I won't go easy on you!!」

0x005505.en: 「If only I'd noticed His Majesty's condition@ sooner... there might have been another way!」

0x005588.en: 「You've no need to regret it...@　All the responsibility lies with me.」

0x0055ED.en: 「No, brother! You can't take responsibility@　like this... there has to be another way!」

0x005668.en: 「Xenia... I'm grateful to you...@　for giving me the power of Duraxil.」

0x0056E8.en: 「Because I built such a thing...!@　If I'd known it would come to this...!」

0x00576E.en: 「Little time left, taking responsibility...@　none of it justifies starting a war!」

0x0057F7.en: 「So that's the voice of your heart, and@　Zamzeed's...!」

0x005834.en: 「Was there really... really no other way,@　Your Highness...?! This is... this is far@　too sad...!」

0x0058BE.en: 「Right now... I can't even spare the time@　to grieve, Presia.」

0x00594E.en: 「There's no way but the unification of all@　La Gias, Raideus.」

0x0059AD.en: 「That's nothing but self-righteousness!@　Have you no thought for the people you'd@　leave behind?!」

0x005A25.en: 「Your Majesty, there's still time!@　Please, step down from that machine!」

0x005A7B.en: 「I cannot stop here, Lieutenant...@　if only to honor the soldiers who marched@　to war on my orders and fell there!」

0x005B2C.en: 「I won't claim it's for the sake of justice!@　I stand on this battlefield following what@　I myself believe in!」

0x005BC2.en: 「So he found something to stand on in Masaki...@　That means he's grown. A good thing.」

0x005C33.en: 「So you'd side with Masaki and the rest...@　No, I saw it coming.」

0x005C95.en: 「I understood His Majesty's will, and I've@　fought to bring peace to Langran as well.」

0x005D1F.en: 「Even if we were dragged in one-sidedly,@　we surface-dwellers affected the state of@　La Gias...」

0x005DB8.en: 「Then setting it right, even a little,@　must be our role.」

0x005E1A.en: 「Heh... meeting all of you was a blessing.@　But setting this chaos right is my role...!」

0x005EBC.en: 「It's over... isn't it... all of it...@　Perhaps... this was for the best...」

0x005F24.en: 「Xenia... Monica... Terius...@　I won't ask you to understand...@　Just... forgive me...」

0x005FD6.en: 「I wanted... to walk the same days as you all...@　How happy that would have been...」

0x006041.en: 「Brother, eject! There's an escape system,@　isn't there?!」

0x00608A.en: 「Ha... haha... Xenia...@　I removed the emergency escape system...」

0x00619E.en: 「?...Monica...? I see... you're safe...@　Thank goodness...」

0x006206.en: 「Huh...?! Brother, what are you saying...?@　I'm...」

0x00627E.en: 「Monica... Xenia...@　The two of you... take care of Lan...@　Langran...」

0x006395.en: （...So that was the other...@　way of taking responsibility...）

0x006448.en: 「Wait, Sir Masaki.@　It's already over. We have no@　will left to fight.」

0x006513.en: 「Yeah... But there could be@　more chaos to come now.」

0x006566.en: 「You needn't worry about that.@　Before he came here, His Majesty@　had put everything in order.」

0x006612.en: 「Upon His Majesty's death, the new Langran@　government dissolves... a new cabinet will@　be decided by general election.」

0x0066BD.en: 「At the same time, an armistice with@　Shutedonias will be signed by the new cabinet.」

0x00671F.en: 「His Majesty foresaw it all...@　It was a death he'd resolved on...」

0x00677B.en: 「A death he'd resolved on?! Don't put it@　that way!!」

0x0067C1.en: 「Feil didn't come here to die!@　He held to his ideal to the very end!」

0x006863.en: 「Even if... even if it was wrong...@　it was the only path he had...」

0x0068DD.en: 「Fighting just to die...@　that's not like you at all...」

0x006958.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Ballantyne Province, Seb Temple

0x0069BB.en: 「Lune,@　so you came to <La Gias> too...」

0x006A0D.en: 「Finally found you.@　It's been rough over on my end.」

0x006A66.en: 「Right, you fought General Kirkus's@　main force.」

0x006AA9.en: 「Still... to think it was Prince Feil@　who set the whole summoning incident@　in motion...」

0x006B2A.en: 「But something set the summoning program@　out of control... and far more surface-dwellers@　than planned got pulled into La Gias.」

0x006C18.en: 「Prince Feil wanted to free Langran from@　Shutedonias's invasion, and he got ahead@　of himself.」

0x006CB7.en: 「He summoned surface-dwellers to boost his@　forces... but it turned out just like Tytti@　said. And that brought even more chaos...」

0x006D7A.en: 「With little time left, the prince resolved@　to unify La Gias by force, to settle it@　and end the fighting...」

0x006E19.en: 「...In the end, Prince Feil reached the@　same conclusion as my father...」

0x006E90.en: 「Yeah... we tried to stop him, but Prince@　Feil chose to take responsibility at the@　cost of his own life...」

0x006F32.en: 「The prince had removed Duraxil's escape@　system beforehand...」

0x006FE1.en: 「I'm Mio Sasuga.@　You're Yang Long of the Granveil, right?@　Nice to meet you.」

0x007078.en: 「Masaki's in Cybuster, Yang Long in Granveil,@　Mio in Zamzeed... so who's piloting@　the last one, Gaddess?」

0x00714F.en: 「You're Lune, right?@　I'm Presia Zan Zenosakis. My big brother@　told me all about you.」

0x00725C.en: 「...Aw man, your side had all the girls.@　I should've stuck with the Hagane.」

0x0072FE.en: 「That kid glued to the ART-1 over there,@　she a friend of yours too?」

0x007382.en: 「...So this is the ART-1...@　The way the R-Series and Huckebein lines@　blend is beautiful.」

0x00742E.en: 「I can, I can.@　The frame's rigidity is up, so shifting the@　center of gravity when it bends looks easy.」

0x0074DA.en: 「She designs <Machine Gods>, after all.@　And she's studied <Personal Troopers>@　and <Specials> too...」

0x007576.en: 「So she's a serious mecha nut, then?」

0x0075AD.en: 「Her tastes run a bit different from Ryusei's.@　She even built a Machine God based on@　the Huckebein.」

0x007723.en: 「That Machine God... Duraxil... was the@　machine Prince Feil last piloted.」

0x007797.en: 「...!@　S-sorry, I got all excited without@　knowing the situation...」

0x0077F7.en: 「No, it's fine. Don't worry about it.@　Sometime, when there's time, I'd love to@　talk mecha with you at length.」

0x0078AD.en: 「Mai...!@　Looks like I made you worry about a lot.」

0x007931.en: 「To think you and Kyosuke, who went@　missing, had come to La Gias...」

0x0079A5.en: 「Well, I was shocked myself when I@　got back to this side.」

0x0079FE.en: 「Hey hey, was Kyosuke lonely, not being@　able to see me?」

0x007A5A.en: 「No, he was the same as always.」

0x007AB3.en: （Though I can't quite picture@　Kyosuke being lonely.）

0x007B09.en: 「So that accounts for everyone from the Steel Dragon@　Squadron summoned to La Gias?」

0x007B9F.en: 「The ATX members besides me, Katina's crew,@　Boss and Princess Shine, and Lune were@　all aboard the Hiryu.」

0x007C3E.en: 「...Lord Raidy, I'm so glad you're safe.」

0x007C7B.en: 「Princess... to think that even you@　had been summoned...」

0x007CD7.en: 「Yes. I was cleaning the@　cockpit of the Fairlion in Ricksent@　when I got pulled in here.」

0x007DA4.en: 「...Say, Kusuha.@　Did you two happen to spot a@　scarlet Series 77... a Vegalion?」

0x007EA3.en: 「Maybe... But I couldn't confirm@　whether she was actually@　aboard it.」

0x007F65.en: 「We did tangle with some annoying@　brats named Murata and Argent, though.」

0x007FCA.en: 「Murata... of the samurai Guarlion?@　He was in La Gias too?」

0x008032.en: 「And to think those three were@　causing trouble for the Hiryu crew...」

0x00809A.en: 「Yeah... as mercenaries for the@　Shtellious army.」

0x0080DA.en: 「Do they mean to stay@　holed up here in La Gias...?」

0x00818C.en: 「Wait, you... you're planning@　to stay down here?」

0x008289.en: 「Ohh, that face... could it be,@　could it really be... you've got@　a thing for little Lune?」

0x008340.en: 「My, my, aren't you easy to read.@　Well, being straightforward is a virtue§」

0x0083A7.en: 「But first... just who are you, kid?」

0x0083D2.en: 「I'm Zashford Zan Valfarbia...@　pilot of the Masoukishin Galguard.」

0x0084DA.en: 「My father caused you all@　a great deal of trouble...@　I'm truly sorry.」

0x008576.en: 「...Colonel Lefina,@　the roll call on our side is complete.」

0x00863E.en: 「Lieutenant Commander Tetsuya...@　thank you for everything.」

0x0086AA.en: 「Colonel Lefina, allow me to@　thank you as well. And also...」

0x00870D.en: 「My brother dragged you all into@　the strife in Langran... could you@　find it in your hearts to forgive him?」

0x008797.en: 「Of course... This whole affair@　taught us a great deal as well...」

0x008802.en: 「The road ahead won't be easy,@　but for La Gias's future, do your best.」

0x008911.en: 「That's right. Blow it once for Presia,@　twice for Tytti, three times for me...」

0x008998.en: 「Ah, never mind. It's a high-performance@　compact ether transceiver. It lets you@　contact La Gias from the surface.」

0x008A34.en: 「If anything comes up, call me.@　If I can help, I will.」

0x008B2F.en: 「Well, same goes for us. Up top we're@　still listed as missing... and once we're@　back, they'll bury us in paperwork for sure.」

0x0093B4.en: 「I know. Whatever Shu and Louzorl@　pull, we'll stop them cold with@　our Masoukishin...!」
